en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1077 - Ammar ibn Musa asked him about a man who hears a sound at the door while he is in prayer and clears his throat to make his servant or family member hear, so that they come and look to see who is at the door. Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in that."

He also asked about a man and a woman who are in prayer and want something, whether it is permissible for them to say "SubhanAllah (swt)."
Imam (as) said: "Yes, and they can gesture to what they want. And a woman, when She wants something, can strike her thighs while in prayer."
